description: Create, update, delete or activate an Auto draft. method=upsert parks a query as a draft without activating it; drafts never evaluate and never fire. method=delete removes a draft. method=convert activates a draft as a live query, which runs unattended and fires its action without asking again, and costs the same as creating a query. upsert and delete are free.

description.description: Description carried into the live query.

draftId.description: Required for delete and convert. Optional on upsert to update.

method.description: upsert creates or updates a draft. delete removes one. convert activates it as a live query.

query.description: EQL query as a JSON object, not a string, with conditions, actions and expiresIn. auto_build drafts one inside its response text. Actions are notify or webhook: a query carrying a credential, such as a telegram_bot botToken or a webhook signingSecret, is refused.

title.description: Title carried into the live query.

name: auto_draft_write
title: Write Auto drafts
